title: Voltas Beko 521L Side by Side Refrigerator
description: This side-by-side refrigerator has a net capacity of 521L and a gross capacity of 563L. It includes 6-in-1 adjustable modes, a ProSmart inverter compressor and Harvest Fresh.

highlights.title: 6-in-1 Adjustable
highlights.subtitle: Adjust between modes effortlessly to suit your needs

highlights.title: Harvest Fresh
highlights.subtitle: Keeps fruits and veggies fresh and nutritious longer

highlights.title: ProSmart Inverter Compressor
highlights.subtitle: Energy efficient, quiet, and built to last
